work_order.title: Inspection of Air Conditioning Unit and Rusted Equipment
work_order.description: Visual inspection of two pieces of equipment was conducted. The air conditioning unit appears intact and in good condition based on the exterior visible in image 0. The other equipment, shown in image 1, exhibits severe rust, corrosion, and bent fins. Professional inspection and likely repair or replacement is recommended for the rusty equipment. No immediate hazard is visually evident but the corrosion could impact operation.

limitations: Equipment identification in image 1 is not possible from photo alone.
